atomicity.reason: One obligation: highest-minus-lowest cell voltage <= 20 mV within 8 h of charge end; the rest/temperature conditions and the relaxation sentence only qualify how and when it is measured.

comprehensibility.reason: Self-contained and readable on its own: 'charge session', 'at rest' and 'cell voltage spread' are ordinary BMS vocabulary and the closing sentence explains why the window includes relaxation time.

feasibility.reason: Balancing to 20 mV in 8 h is achievable with known passive or active balancing only for a bounded starting imbalance and sufficient balancing current (e.g. a 100-200 mA passive bleed moves only about 0.8-1.6 Ah in 8 h); neither is stated, and no architecture element satisfies the requirement yet (gap marker), so achievability is not evidenced.
feasibility.suggestion: State the maximum starting imbalance and the balancing capability assumed, and allocate the requirement to an architecture element.

parent_fit.reason: US_CELL_BALANCING asks that a resting pack, within a stated time after a charge session ends, shows its cell voltages converged into a stated narrow band; the requirement states exactly that band (20 mV) and time (8 h).

unambiguity.reason: The clock start ('end of a charge session': charge termination versus charger disconnect), the instant at which the spread is read (at the 8 h mark or once anywhere inside the window) and the case where the pack leaves rest or the 15-45 degC band during the window are not pinned down.
unambiguity.suggestion: Define the start event, state that the spread is read at t = 8 h on settled voltages, and say whether the target is deferred or waived when the rest or temperature conditions are not met.

verifiability.reason: Threshold, unit and deadline are concrete, but the measurement conditions are not: 'at rest' has no current limit, 'settled' has no relaxation criterion, and the starting spread the 8 h target applies to is unbounded, so a tester has to choose them.
verifiability.suggestion: Quantify the conditions (e.g. pack current below X A for Y min, voltage drift below Z mV/min) and state the initial spread or charge state from which the 8 h target is verified.

summary: Parent-aligned balancing target (20 mV within 8 h) whose measurement conditions ('at rest', 'settled', start of the 8 h clock) are unquantified and whose achievability depends on an unstated starting imbalance.
